name: My Khanh tourist village
kicker: Orchard and folk-games park on the Cần Thơ river
summary: Fruit-garden park on the Cần Thơ river: pick fruit, watch the pig races, and eat lunch after the boats. The adult gate is 149,000 VND and covers the races, a 115-year-old southern house, and a noodle workshop. It is a built tourist park. Skip it if you came only for the floating market.
getThere: About twenty minutes by road from the centre
heroCaption: The gate of Mỹ Khánh village under palm trees
body: The village spreads over more than 30 ha on the bank of the Cần Thơ river, between the Cái Răng and Phong Điền markets. Walk the orchards, pick fruit in season, and step inside the 115-year-old southern house and the flower garden.

Shows run on a timetable. Pig and dog races start at 9:45, 11:00, 13:00, and 15:00, and an animal circus plays at 10:30, 11:30, 13:30, and 15:30. In the craft village you can watch hủ tiếu noodles, coconut candy, and folk cakes being made.
Lunch is garden food: cá rô kho tộ, grilled snakehead, bún nước lèo, field-crab hotpot, and bánh xèo. Come in the late morning, after the floating market.

figures.caption: Jackfruit ripening on a tree in the Mỹ Khánh gardens
figures.alt: Jackfruit hanging from a tree trunk in the gardens of My Khanh village

gettingThere: The village is at 335 Lộ Vòng Cung, phường An Bình, about twenty minutes by road from the centre. Trúc Lâm Phương Nam monastery is a few hundred metres away.

legs.heading: From Ninh Kiều
legs.body: By car or motorbike, about twenty minutes.

legs.heading: From Trúc Lâm Phương Nam
legs.body: A few hundred metres along the same road.

admissionNote: Adult over 1.3 m 149,000 VND. Child from 1 m to under 1.3 m 99,000 VND. Under 1 m free. The gate includes the races, the circus, the old house, the flower garden, and the craft village. Fruit picking is priced by the garden. Pedal boats, the glass bridge, and the pool are 50,000 VND each, and go-karts 100,000 VND.
